hebrewText: וּ/דְמ֞וּת עַל רָאשֵׁ֤י הַ/חַיָּה֙ רָקִ֔יעַ כְּ/עֵ֖ין הַ/קֶּ֣רַח הַ/נּוֹרָ֑א נָט֥וּי עַל רָאשֵׁי/הֶ֖ם מִ/לְ/מָֽעְלָ/ה

tokens.bdb: resemblance; concretely, model, shape; adverbially, like
tokens.explanation: demut — semelhança, forma, aparência, parecido com

tokens.bdb: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
tokens.kjv: above, according to(-ly), after, (as) against, among, and, [idiom] as, at, because of, beside (the rest of), between, beyond the time, [idiom] both and, by (reason of), [idiom] had the charge of, concerning for, in (that), (forth, out) of, (from) (off), (up-) on, over, than, through(-out), to, touching, [idiom] with.
tokens.explanation: al — sobre, acima, contra, em relação a

tokens.bdb: the head (as most easily shaken), whether literal or figurative (in many applications, of place, time, rank, itc.)
tokens.kjv: band, beginning, captain, chapiter, chief(-est place, man, things), company, end, [idiom] every (man), excellent, first, forefront, (be-)head, height, (on) high(-est part, (priest)), [idiom] lead, [idiom] poor, principal, ruler, sum, top.

tokens.bdb: alive; hence, raw (flesh); fresh (plant, water, year), strong; also (as noun, especially in the feminine singular and masculine plural) life (or living thing), whether literally or figuratively
tokens.kjv: [phrase] age, alive, appetite, (wild) beast, company, congregation, life(-time), live(-ly), living (creature, thing), maintenance, [phrase] merry, multitude, [phrase] (be) old, quick, raw, running, springing, troop.
tokens.explanation: chai — vivo, vivente, ser que tem vida

tokens.bdb: properly, an expanse, i.e. the firmament or (apparently) visible arch of the sky
an eye (literally or figuratively); by analogy, a fountain (as the eye of the landscape)
tokens.kjv: affliction, outward appearance, [phrase] before, [phrase] think best, colour, conceit, [phrase] be content, countenance, [phrase] displease, eye((-brow), (-d), -sight), face, [phrase] favour, fountain, furrow (from the margin), [idiom] him, [phrase] humble, knowledge, look, ([phrase] well), [idiom] me, open(-ly), [phrase] (not) please, presence, [phrase] regard, resemblance, sight, [idiom] thee, [idiom] them, [phrase] think, [idiom] us, well, [idiom] you(-rselves).
tokens.explanation: ayin — olho, olhos, aparência, fonte (de água), perspectiva

tokens.bdb: ice (as if bald, i.e. smooth); hence, hail; by resemblance, rock crystal
to fear; morally, to revere; caus. to frighten
tokens.kjv: affright, be (make) afraid, dread(-ful), (put in) fear(-ful, -fully, -ing), (be had in) reverence(-end), [idiom] see, terrible (act, -ness, thing).

tokens.kjv: [phrase] afternoon, apply, bow (down, -ing), carry aside, decline, deliver, extend, go down, be gone, incline, intend, lay, let down, offer, outstretched, overthrown, pervert, pitch, prolong, put away, shew, spread (out), stretch (forth, out), take (aside), turn (aside, away), wrest, cause to yield.
